workers.name: Codex independent Beiqishu 028 canonical chronology auditor

summary: Fresh complete independent canonical audit: all 149 Chinese units, 135 temporal or active-hint items, and 46 people were checked. Regnal dates, era ranges, precision, event ownership, and later-reception classifications are otherwise source-grounded. Thirty-eight linked claim/hint items across nineteen people require revision because genealogy, undated title/context, literary allusion, and ruler-related narrative were converted into unsupported personal activity dates. The chapter remains needs-revision; this audit makes no extraction change.
